role: Plain tool (not a gate): builds a hud_live_state from the last row of an oracle scene's state/frames.jsonl, asks raster_hud_live_json for the generated HUD fields, and compares them field by field with the recorded hud object. It skips the live-only top-level fields (the boss status and the chat) and a null guiScreen.
notes: Covers the HUD state inputs: health bar (hp, previous hp, absorption, hurt resistance), armor, food and saturation, air, xp bar, hotbar and armor slots, highlighted item name and timer, vignette, brightness, achievement toast. The GuiIngame/GuiAchievement member names are the vanilla methods these fields feed; which fields raster.c derives in which vanilla method was not verified. Built by the Makefile's plain-tool rule, so it runs outside make test. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
